headline: Replit Selects OpenAI to Replace Anthropic as Default
body: The CEO announced that OpenAI is taking over Anthropic's role as the default model. Platform users can nevertheless continue to access Claude.

Replit Selects OpenAI to Replace Anthropic as Default

The CEO announced that OpenAI is taking over Anthropic's role as the default model. Platform users can nevertheless continue to access Claude.
